caseNameFull: Hopi Indian Tribe v. Block, Secretary of Agriculture and Navajo Medicinemen's Assn. v. Block, Secretary of Agriculture

opinions.text:
C. A. D. C. Cir. Motion of All Indian Pueblo Council et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae in No. 83-589 granted. Certiorari denied.

Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and these petitions.

Reported below: 228 U. S. App. D. C. 166, 708 F. 2d 735.
